title: Schema tests: pin the property sets of the closed count maps
lead: The schema tests check that every listed key of the closed count maps is accepted and that specific bad keys are refused, but not that each map's property set equals its vocabulary: adding "weird" to `$defs/lineKinds.properties` leaves all Schema tests green (same for typeVotes, nullTokens and the header-convention counts). Assert the exact property set of each map against the vocabulary. Nit: `IdMatches` in SchemaValueTests accepts a tag without a patch number (v1.1); tighten if releases always use three-part tags.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: 1. Failing mutants (an extra key in each map); 2. assert the exact sets; 3. mutation-check.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Build, test and format pass; `slicer check` passes.
